storage.recoveryBlockedDescription: Review the unreadable stored data before new changes can be saved.

feedback.createdSessionOnly: Task created for this session only. It was not saved.
feedback.updatedSessionOnly: Task updated for this session only. It was not saved.
feedback.deletedSessionOnly: Task deleted for this session only. The deletion was not saved.
feedback.statusSessionOnly: Task status changed for this session only. It was not saved.
feedback.restoredPartial: Tasks restored. Some stored records could not be read.
feedback.updatedElsewhere: Tasks were updated in another tab.

feedback.newerData: Newer tasks were found in another tab. Reload to see them before saving.
feedback.conflict: Your change was not saved because newer data exists. Reload to review it.
feedback.retryFailed: Changes are still not saved. They apply only to this session.
feedback.discarded: Unreadable stored data was discarded and restored tasks were saved.
feedback.protected: Stored data was preserved. Saving remains disabled until you discard unreadable data or reload.
feedback.scheduledSessionOnly: Task scheduled for this session only. It was not saved.
feedback.unscheduledSessionOnly: Schedule removed for this session only. It was not saved.
